items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023

ctx.x: I recall when I interviewed him I was enamored at the time — well when he first came up with his first orchestral piece, I think it was called “Elementals.” And he didn’t know what he was doing. He pretty much told me, he said, “I didn’t know how to score, I didn’t know ranges really well.” And I could almost picture some of the orchestral people going, “I can’t read this, who did this?”
